summary.headline: Astrological Judgments of Lifespan
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging nourishment and length of life from the Moon, ascendant, Sun, malefics, and the almuten of the native. Degrees separating these significators from malefics determine lifespan in days, months, or years, while afflicted triplicity lords and the Lord of the Anauba signify impeded nourishment or short life.
